WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Numbers are the client's at build 1.60.1.70938 with Blizzard's hotfixes through November 12. Talent orders are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's published builds, named and dated where they appear. The level 60 rotation comes from those two sites and from WoWSims, which is a model, plus one level 41 to 45 combat log WoWSims has fitted. No raid is open until December 9, so nothing here rests on a raid log, and both sites say their stat pages are provisional until then. If a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text.

On this page

  • What Balance is for
  • Your talent points
  • Rotation
  • Stat priority
  • What defines Balance
  • What Forever changed for Balance
  • At level 60

What Balance is for

Damage from outside melee, with heals and crowd control still on the bar. Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2/2 adds 20% range to your Balance spells and 4% hit. Entangling RootsEntangling RootsLevel 8 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secRoots the target in place and causes 20 Nature damage over 12 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time. works indoors and holds up to 3 targets with OvergrowthOvergrowthTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.. You can heal a dungeon in a Balance build while levelling: both sites say so, and you keep every healing spell outside Moonkin FormMoonkin FormLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35% of base ManaDurationUntil cancelledShapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects..

What the sites say about levelling it. Wowhead (November 4): "Balance leveling in Forever is more viable than it ever was in Classic. It will reward players who plan their pulls rather than pushing from quest to quest. Expect to spend time drinking…" Icy Veins (November 4): the start is slow, and "once you are Level 25 or so, it becomes a very fun spec to level." Both list the same weaknesses: slow early levels, Mana, and no real area damage until 40.

One live report (reported, one player): Bulwark levelled Balance to 44 on a PvP realm and describes slow single-target kills, almost no drinking once Improved WrathImproved WrathTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.5 sec and its Mana cost by 50%. and ReflectionReflectionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. were in, and healing every dungeon up to Razorfen Downs on a Balance build.

Why it leaves the tree at 15. Nature's FocusNature's FocusTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives your Arcane and Nature spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage. 5/5 is a 70% chance not to lose cast time when hit, and ReflectionReflectionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. 3/3 keeps 50% of your Mana regeneration running while you cast. Icy Veins: Reflection's points "can reduce your downtime by quite a lot." NaturalistNaturalistTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by 0.5 sec and increases all damage you deal by 10%. 5/5 at 40 to 44 is +10% to all damage.

Why EclipseEclipseTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantYour Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.50 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec. waits until 45. Icy Veins: Eclipse "comes online very late in your levelling journey", and before it you "mostly pretend [Starfire] doesn't exist." VengeanceVengeanceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%. is left for last because "we have so little crit chance while leveling."

Dual Specialization is sold by your class trainer at 40 for 50 gold, per Wowhead, so a healing or Feral second build is a purchase, not a respec.

Stat priority

While levelling: your highest item level pieces, then Spell Power, then Intellect. Wowhead: "Upgrade your weapon early. Caster weapons carry spell damage from level 10." Between two otherwise equal pieces the leather one wins, for the armour (ours, not a source's).

At 60, hit comes first. Spells need 17% hit against a raid boss, and Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2/2 supplies 4%, so 13% comes from gear.

  1. Icy Veins (November 4): hit to 17%, critical strike, Spell Power, Intellect
  2. Wowhead (October 30, labelled speculative): hit to 17%, spell damage, spell penetration, critical strike, haste, Intellect, Spirit
  3. WoWSims' weights (WoWSims' model): hit 1.48, spell damage 1, haste 0.99, critical strike 0.76, Intellect 0.28, Spirit 0

Arcane damage serves MoonfireMoonfireLevel 4 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration9 secBurns the enemy for 10 to 12 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec. and StarfireStarfireLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 7Cast3.5 sec castCost95 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 111 to 133 Arcane damage to the target., Nature damage serves WrathWrathLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost10 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 15 to 17 Nature damage to the target., Insect SwarmInsect SwarmLevel 20 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secThe enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec. and HurricaneHurricaneLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost880 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration10 secCreates a violent storm in the target area causing 69 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell., and plain Spell Power serves both. Critical strikes deal double with VengeanceVengeanceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%. 5/5. Haste does not speed up damage-over-time ticks. Icy Veins: "Do not take this stat priority too seriously until we have Level 60 data."
